history.query: Which is the second largest moon in the solar system?
history.response:
**The second largest moon in the solar system is Titan, Saturns biggest moon.** It is only slightly smaller than Jupiters Ganymede and is even larger than the planet Mercury. [[0]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Titan_%28moon%29) [[1]](https://solarsystem.nasa.gov/moons/saturn-moons/titan/in-depth.amp)

Titan has a **radius of about 2,575 km**, making it nearly 50% wider than Earths Moon. It is unique because it has a **dense nitrogen-rich atmosphere** and features **lakes, rivers, and seas of liquid methane and ethane**, making it the only world besides Earth with stable surface liquids. Titan was discovered in **1655 by Christiaan Huygens** and remains a prime target for exploration due to its Earth-like weather cycle and potential subsurface ocean.
